prompt: Compose one complete original 60-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: nimble swinging jazz trio with dry piano accents. Instruments: acoustic piano, upright bass, brushed drums. Tempo 132 BPM. Distinct motif: a bright five-note arch. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 40-second process film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:58, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An upbeat and sophisticated instrumental track with a jazzy swing feel. Features a prominent piano melody, walking bass, light drums, and a smooth saxophone solo. The arrangement is clean and energetic.
